name: VC Trader AI Modify Position Protection
description: Autonomously modify a live position's stop-loss / take-profit while the account is set to act autonomously; otherwise the call does not go through and NOTHING is staged for approval (execution_status 'downgraded' + lock_reason); the position keeps its old protection. Calls the propfirm_manager BFF as the workspace owner (PFM_AGENT_TOKEN) at /api/v1/workspaces/{ws}/live/positions/{position_id}/agent-protection.
